title: A characterization of the finite model property for $ω$-categorical theories
summary: A first-order theory $T$ has the {\em finite model property} if every first-order sentence that is implied by $T$ has a finite model. We give a characterization of when a complete $ω$-categorical theory $T$ has the finite model property. The characterization makes it possible to transfer stability theoretic results in [29] to certain classes of finite structures.
